lines.en: I tap on Chika's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Chika 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : Hihi~ Good morning, Sensei. You're up early today.
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻～早上好，Sensei。你今天起得挺早呀。
: 有什么原因吗？

lines.en: : Just seeing what you're up to.
lines.zh: : 就是看看你在干什么。

lines.en: : Wanna see for yourself and come on over?
lines.zh: : 要不要自己过来看看？
: 我给你做早饭～

lines.en: Being the type who never says no to free breakfast (Or cute girls), I get dressed and take the bus over to the second half of town...
lines.zh: 我这种人从来不会拒绝免费的早饭（也不会拒绝可爱的女孩），于是换好衣服，坐公交去了城市另一半……

lines.en: I show up to find Chika stirring a pot of beef stew on the stove.
lines.zh: 到了之后，我看见 Chika 正在灶台前搅一锅炖牛肉。

lines.en: And while this isn't exactly the type of breakfast I envisioned, I decide to go along with it.
lines.zh: 虽然这跟我原本想象的早饭不太一样，我还是决定顺着她来。

lines.en: I vaguely remember a time in my life where I wound up making similar dishes due to the low price point-
lines.zh: 我隐约记得自己人生中有过一段日子，因为价格便宜，也常做差不多的菜——

lines.en: But that memory fades as the two of us get to talking about some gossip she heard involving some of her coworkers at the mall.
lines.zh: 但那点记忆很快就淡了，因为我俩开始聊起她在商场听同事说的八卦。

lines.en: Chika finishes 'breakfast' and the two of us eat together while Chinami watches TV in the other room.
lines.zh: Chika 把「早饭」弄好，我俩一起吃，Chinami 在另一个房间看电视。

lines.en: It feels almost like I'm part of the family for a moment or two.
lines.zh: 有那么一会儿，我几乎觉得自己是这个家的一员。

lines.en: And then it feels even stranger when I realize Chika is playing the 'mother' role when she very much could be my daughter.
lines.zh: 接着我意识到 Chika 在扮演「母亲」的角色——而她明明很可能是我女儿那个年纪，这感觉就更奇怪了。

lines.en: But regardless, we take our time enjoying the beef stew and wind up walking to the bus stop together so Chika can make it to work on time.
lines.zh: 不过不管怎样，我们慢慢把炖牛肉吃完，然后一起走到公交站，好让 Chika 能准时上班。

lines.en: I get off at the last stop and decide to get on with my day...
lines.zh: 我在终点站下车，决定继续过我的这一天……
